hypothesis: Observed acquisition before self-contact assigns correction to both persistent latent branches, repairing the v1 mixture credit-assignment stall at unchanged architecture/objective and matched within-study exposure.

arms.alias: Keep observed informative contact1; replace contact2 with self-contact on a pre-known untouched entity, for one starting-zero and one starting-one lineage per entity count.

substitution.eligibility: Select first distinct two_contact lineage per N and untouched prebit0/1 using anchor plus leading set only. Target is first eligible sorted ID outside acquisition operands. No outcome/mode-based selection.
substitution.starting_bits: Two views per N/prebit; related reversed-acquisition views stay dependent.
substitution.matched: Initialization, episode IDs, action kinds/counts, sensor coverage, masks, visible bits, batch geometry, updates and CPU ceilings; actual consumed compute measured.
substitution.changed: Only selected contact2 becomes alias and subsequent observed consequences change. The informative first contact and its full feedback are identical in both arms.
substitution.environment_modes: Selected source lineages use (N-3+prebit)%2 before final realization in BOTH arms: one of each mode per N, two lineages per mode/prebit across N. This supplied allocation never enters learner inputs.
substitution.between_studies: V2 uses a fresh bank; compare exposure between its arms. V1 and v2 event/bit inventories differ and cross-study performance is descriptive.

evaluation.self_canonical_exclusions: Both current training tapes, reserved splits, current evaluation, historical continuation self, opened alias-v1 self queries and both alias-v1 training tapes.
evaluation.self_partition: in_family in combined plan; action exposure differs deliberately between arms
evaluation.oracle: Existing independently coded conditional oracle under supplied binary-contact-v1 law; same-author public custody.
evaluation.historical_canonical_overlap: Reported descriptively for the whole bank, not hidden or claimed absent.

analysis.retention: Zero newly wrong continuation queries relative to paired ordinary control; >=95% continuation accuracy and role-pair conjunction, full support, zero unchanged-bit errors.
analysis.self: At least95% exact each starting bit per seed, full support and no unchanged-bit errors.
analysis.proper_scores: Raw joint NLL/Brier/ECE10; zero truth probability retains infinite NLL, abstention missing proper score.
analysis.missing_forecasts: Incorrect on every planned denominator; never delete failure suffixes.
analysis.inferential_scope: Descriptive paired evidence intervention on one fresh public bank; no population significance, independent-world generalization, or same-bank v1-v2 causal superiority claim.

decision_order: STOP_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION if any unknown failure, incomplete inventory, interrupted execution, invalid identity or unequal prescribed updates
REVISE_EVIDENCE_FIX if any candidate self/continuation/support/preservation/retention criterion fails
KEEP_EVIDENCE_FIX if mean self gain >=0.20 and positive for every seed

execution.source_fix: Reuses active-inference-v6 unchanged; no neural, objective, optimizer, checkpoint or inference source changes. Reuses the same study runner/data module.

Retain measured incorrect/unproduced points. Every other exception or missing trial makes execution incomplete.
